title: Greet and introduce yourself
bridge: Isi-Spanish, ukuba usalutha usho 'Hola' okanye 'Buenos días' futhi ukuba uhlonipha usho 'Me llamo...' okanye 'Soy...'. Isi-English kunjalo: siyaletha 'Hello' okanye 'Good morning' futhi si sho 'My name is...' okanye 'I am...'. Isahluko esibalulekile ngisho futhi esingekho isi-English asisho 'I am called...' (nakhu ngokwenhlamba iyofanana, kuvele kakhulu futhi akukho kuvele kakhulu ekuvumelani komsuka). Khumbula futhi ukuthi isi-English siyayithatha isikhathi eside ukuba sibe 'to be' ukuba sibuze igama: 'What is your name?' (hhayi 'How are you called?').
rule: Ukuba usalutha: 'Hello' (Hola), 'Hi' (kakhulu kuvele), 'Good morning' (Buenos días), 'Good afternoon' (Buenas tardes), 'Good evening' (Buenas noches ukuya). Ukuba uhlonipha: 'My name is...' (Me llamo...) okanye 'I am...' (Soy...). Ukuba ubuze igama: 'What is your name?' (¿Cómo te llamas?). Ukuba uphendule ukusalutha: 'Nice to meet you' (Encantado/a de conocerte) futhi isiphendulo 'Nice to meet you too'. Ukuba usukuma: 'Goodbye', 'Bye', 'See you later'.

common_error.explanation: Isi-Spanish si sho 'Me llamo Anna', kodwa isi-English indlela efanelekile kakhulu yokuhlalela ngiyeyokuthi 'My name is...' okanye 'I am...'. 'I am called' iyofanana kodwa kuvele kakhulu futhi akukho kuvele kakhulu emikhalweni yokusuka.

title: Give personal information (age, nationality, profession)
bridge: Isi-Spanish, ukuze uqike umshana usho ‘Tengo 25 años’ (esebenzisa isivakalisi ‘tener’), kodwa isi-English usho ‘I am 25 years old’ (esebenzisa isivakalisi ‘to be’). Nalo ukuba ngumZulu usho ‘Ngiyimfana/Ngiyinkosikazi’ (ngaphandle kwesihloko), kodwa isi-English usho ‘I am Zulu’ (ngaphandle kwesihloko). Ngokwempumelo, isi-Spanish usho ‘Soy profesor/a’ (ngaphandle kwesihloko), kodwa isi-English idinga isihloko: ‘I am a teacher’.
rule: Ngokweshumi: ‘I am [inumela] years old’ (okuj: I am 25 years old). Ngokwezwe: ‘I am [izwe]’ (okuj: I am Zulu, I am Mexican). Ngokwempumelo: ‘I am a/an [umpumelo]’ (okuj: I am a doctor, I am an engineer). Ukubuzwa: ‘How old are you?’ (Uneminyaka emingaki?), ‘Where are you from?’ (Uvelaphi?), ‘What do you do?’ (Uwenze njani?) okanye ‘What is your job?’.

common_error.explanation: Isi-Spanish usho ‘Tengo 25 años’ esebenzisa isivakalisi ‘tener’, kodwa isi-English esebenzisa isivakalisi ‘to be’ ukuba ngomshana. Kungomunye wamagamagamaya amaningi abasabelo isi-Spanish abayenzayo.

title: Describe objects and people (basic)
bridge: Ngesi, ukuze sicazise izinto nabantu siyabeka isicazisi emva kwesiga: 'un coche rojo', 'una chica alta'. Kulo-English, isicazisi siyakubeka PHAMBILI kwesiga: 'a red car', 'a tall girl'. Leso lanye, siyasebenza nge-verb 'to be' ukuze sicazise okuthile (She is tall) futhi 'have got' ukuze sicazise izici zomzimba (She has got blue eyes).
rule: Ukuze sicazise: 1) Isicazisi + isiga (a big house). 2) Umsebenzi + verb 'to be' + isicazisi (The house is big). 3) Umsebenzi + 'have/has got' + isici (She has got long hair). Ama-adjective amaningi: big (nkulu), small (ncane), tall (phakeme), short (ncane), beautiful (mnandi), old (mdala), young (shaqi), fast (ngokushesha), slow (ngokushesha).

common_error.explanation: Ngesi, isicazisi siyakubeka emva kwesiga ('un coche rojo'), kodwa kulo-English isicazisi siyakubeka PHAMBILI kwesiga ('a red car'). Le yinto enkulu kakhulu eyenziwa ngabantu abaqhubeka isiNgisi.

examples.note: Siyasebenza nge-'to be' ukuze sicazise okuthile.
Siyasebenza nge-'have got' ukuze sicazise izici zomzimba.

examples.original: My brother is young and he has got green eyes.
examples.phonetic: /maɪ ˈbrʌðə ɪz jʌŋ ænd hiː hæz ɡɒt ɡriːn aɪz/
examples.note: Ukuze qhubeke nge-'to be' futhi 'have got'.

title: Talk about daily routines
bridge: Ngesi, ukukhuluma ngemithetho yosuku lusebenza ngokwasemaphakathe, sisebenzisa isikhathi esihambisana: 'Ngivuka nga-7, ngidlala ngesikhathi sokudla futhi ngiyahela emsebenzini'. Ngesilinganiso, sisebenzisa isikhathi esihambisana ngendlela efananayo: 'I get up at 7, have breakfast and go to work'. Uph相hlu lo muzwa ukuthi ngesi sisebenzisa iziphuzu ezinjengokuthi 'at' ngesikhathi ('at 7 o'clock'), 'in' ngesikhathi sokuqubuda ('in the morning') futhi 'on' ngosuku ('on Monday'). Futhi sisebenzisa amazwi okuthi 'always', 'usually', 'sometimes' phambi kwesiga esikhulu.
rule: Ukukhuluma ngemithetho: 1) Sebenzisa isikhathi esihambisana (I get up, she works). 2) Sebenzisa iziphuzu zosikhathi: 'at' + isikhathi (at 8 am), 'in' + isikhathi sokuqubuda (in the morning), 'on' + usuku (on Friday). 3) Sebenzisa amazwi okuthi phambi kwesiga esikhulu (I always eat breakfast). 4) Ukubuza: 'What time do you get up?' okanye 'When do you have lunch?'.

concept_examples.text: She usually has breakfast at 8 am.
concept_examples.translation: Yena uyadlala ngesikhathi sokudla nga-8 ekuseni.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ʃiː ˈjuːʒuəli hæz ˈbrekfəst æt eɪt æm/

concept_examples.text: We go to work at 9 in the morning.
concept_examples.phonetic: /wiː ɡəʊ tə wɜːk æt naɪn ɪn ðə ˈmɔːnɪŋ/

concept_examples.text: What time do you have dinner?

common_error.wrong: I am eating breakfast every morning.
common_error.explanation: Ngesilinganiso, ngenkathi sisebenzisa isikhathi esihambisana ukukhuluma ngemithetho yosuku lusebenza, ngesi asisebenzisi isikhathi esihambisana, kodwa sisebenzisa isikhathi esihambisana, hhayi isikhathi esihlezi.

examples.phonetic: /aɪ hæv lʌntʃ æt wʌn piː em/

examples.original: What time do you go to bed?
examples.phonetic: /wɒt taɪm duː juː ɡəʊ tə bed/

title: Express likes and dislikes (Ngiyithanda / Angithandi)
bridge: NgisiZulu, ukuze sicazise izinto esithandayo, siyathusa isivumelwano 'thanda': 'Ngiyithanda umacelo' (ngokungukuthi 'Umacelo ngiyithanda'). NgesiNgisi, siyathusa isivumelwano 'like' nesimo somsebenzi osibhalo + like + into: 'I like pizza'. Isahluko esikhulu ngukuthi ngisiZulu isivumelwano 'thanda' sizama ne-into (ngiyithanda umacelo, ngiyithanda amacele), ngesiNgisi 'like' sizama nomsebenzi (I like pizza, He likes pizza). Khumbula futhi ukuthi ukuze ucazise ukungathandi, sithi 'I don't like' (angithandi).
rule: Ukuze ucazise izinto esithandayo: 1) Okukhethekile: I/you/we/they like + into (I like coffee). He/she/it likes + into (She likes coffee). 2) Okungakhethekile: I/you/we/they don't like (I don't like tea). He/she/it doesn't like (He doesn't like tea). 3) Imibuzo: Do you like...? (Uyathanda...?), Does she like...? (Uyathanda yini...?). 4) Ukuze uqine: 'I like it very much' (Ngiyithanda kakhulu) okanye 'I really like it' (Ngiyithanda kakhulu).

common_error.explanation: NgisiZulu, igama elishiya 'kakhulu' liya emva kwesivumelwano: 'Ngiyithanda kakhulu umacelo'. NgesiNgisi, igama elishiya 'very much' liya ekupheleni komlando okanye emva kwento: 'I like pizza very much'. Ukulibeka phakathi kwesivumelwano nento yindlela ephuthaphutheka.

examples.note: Ibuzo no- 'do' + umsebenzi + isivumelwano ngesimo somsebenzi osibhalo.

title: Ask for and give prices
bridge: Kulesipani, ukubuzela inani sisithi ‘Ingabe yimalini?’ okanye ‘Yimalini?’. NgesiNgisi, sisithi ‘How much is it?’ (singular) okanye ‘How much are they?’ (plural). Kusenjalo, sisebenzisa ‘How much does it cost?’ (Ingabe yimalini?). Ududuzatsu okuqakatheke yikuthi ngesiNgisi sisebenzisa isivumelwano ‘to be’ okanye ‘cost’ kanye nomphatha ‘does’ ukubuzela.
rule: Ukubuzela inani: 1) ‘How much is it?’ (into eyodwa) okanye ‘How much are they?’ (izinto eziningi). 2) ‘How much does it cost?’ (Ingabe yimalini?). 3) ‘How much is the T-shirt?’ (Ingabe yimalini ishethi?). Ukuphendula: ‘It is 25 dollars’ okanye ‘It costs 25 dollars’. Emibuzweni, sisebenzisa isivumelwano ‘to be’ okanye umphatha ‘does’ + ‘cost’.

common_error.explanation: Kulesipani sisithi ‘Ingabe yimalini?’ ngaphandle komphatha. NgesiNgisi, une ‘cost’, siyidinga umphatha ‘does’ ukubuzela. Yindlela ephulwe kakhulu abasabelo basiNgisi ngenxa yokuhumusha ngokwenene.

examples.original: How much does the bag cost?

title: Bonisa indawo yezindawo
bridge: NgesiSpani, ukuze kubonise indawo yezindawo siya 'Isesikhombisi...', 'Isesidingo sobhedu', 'Isesidingo sokudla'. Ngesi, siyathatha izaphazimazitha zokudla njengokuthi 'on', 'in', 'at', 'next to', 'near', 'opposite', 'behind', 'in front of'. Ingcinga kumaSpani akuthi ngesiSpani siyathatha 'en' ngezinto zonke, kodwa ngesi isaphazimazitha isilinganiselwe ngokwesiqhelo. Khumbula futhi ukuthi ukubekwa kwesidingo siyathatha isisho 'to be' (It is...).
rule: Ukuze ubonise indawo: 1) Thatha isisho 'to be' (The bank is...). 2) Izaphazimazitha zokudla: 'on' (on, phezu kwesikhalo okudla), 'in' (phakathi kwesikhalo), 'at' (kwisikhalo esilinganiselwe), 'next to' (ngakufuphi), 'near' (ngakufuphi), 'opposite' (phambi kwesikhalo), 'behind' (emva kwesikhalo), 'in front of' (phambi kwesikhalo). 3) Ukuze buze: 'Where is the...?' (Uphi...?) okanye 'Is there a... near here?' (Kukhona... ngakufuphi lapha?).

concept_examples.text: The supermarket is near the park.
The school is next to the church.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðə skuːl ɪz nekst tə ðə tʃɜːtʃ/

concept_examples.text: The pharmacy is on Main Street.

common_error.explanation: NgesiSpani siya 'Isesikhombisi' futhi ngenkathi-ke siyekela umphathi. Ngesi, umphathi 'It' okanye 'He/She' uyadingeka. Ngaphandle kwalokho, 'sesikhombisi' siyasho 'on the corner' (hhayi 'in the corner') lapho indawo iyisesikhombisi sezindawo eziphelelelane.

examples.original: The cat is in the garden.
The restaurant is next to the hotel.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈrestrɒnt ɪz nekst tə ðə həʊˈtel/

examples.original: The bank is opposite the park.
